about: M2 (On or off? Unit commitment as a mixed-integer program). Prairie Town's fleet from lesson 0 (town.json) on 29 July 2025, the 2025 summer day with the highest hourly demand on the Southwest Power Pool grid (EIA-930 shapes in town_days.json, key summer_peak), scaled to the town exactly as lesson 0 scales its day (grid-operator.js prepare(): wind and solar = shape x farm size, rounded; demand = shape x 450 MW, rounded so that the need left for gas is a multiple of 5 MW). The switching data of the two gas plants (minimum output, no-load and start-up costs, minimum run and down times, states before and after the day) and the unserved-energy penalty are illustrative. The reference block is precomputed with HiGHS from this model (labeled precomputed where the page shows it before a solve).

dataset.creator: Honglin Li
dataset.status: Illustrative: the gas plants' switching data and the unserved-energy penalty are invented; the day's shapes are real SPP data from 29 July 2025 (EIA-930), scaled to Prairie Town.
dataset.source: Prepared by hand for lesson M2 from lesson 0's town data; the reference results are solved with HiGHS as a mixed-integer program.
dataset.license: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), Honglin Li. Values taken from the sources listed in this file keep their publishers' terms; EIA data are U.S. government works in the public domain.

day.label: 29 July 2025
day.note: the 2025 summer day with the highest hourly demand, among days with no repaired hours
day.units: MW, hour by hour (local time, Central daylight time)

fleet_note: min = minimum output when on (MW); noload = $ per hour on; startup = $ per start; up and down = minimum run and down times (hours); init = on (1) or off (0) before the day; end = state required in the last hour. All illustrative; the peaker's 30 MW minimum is lesson 11's.
penalty_note: Cost per MWh of unserved demand: a large illustrative number, as in lesson 11, so that a shortage of supply never makes a node of the branch-and-bound tree infeasible (switches that break a minimum run or down time still can).

reference.label: precomputed with HiGHS 1.15 (the steps above solve the same models live)

eia-930.text: EIA, Hourly Electric Grid Monitor (Form EIA-930), Southwest Power Pool
